# Browser playback fixture

`segment.bin` is the first 10-second, 320×184 H.264/AAC MPEG-TS segment of
Big Buck Bunny from Mux's public HLS test stream:
https://test-streams.mux.dev/x36xhzz/x36xhzz.m3u8

Source segment: https://test-streams.mux.dev/x36xhzz/url_2/url_526/193039199_mp4_h264_aac_ld_7.ts

Big Buck Bunny © 2008 Blender Foundation, https://www.bigbuckbunny.org/,
licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

Used unchanged as an offline browser test fixture. The browser harness serves
it through a deterministic HLS playlist; it is not included in the deployed site.
